# Numbers of agents, AI apps and the assistant

<!-- GENERATED by `cargo xtask gen api` from the numbers in the code. Do not edit this page by hand. -->

These are the limits of agents and of the assistant, as Bugaboo works by them. A *turn* is one question or one answer of a conversation. A *tool* is what an agent, an AI app or the assistant uses to look something up or to change it, such as reading an issue. An administrator can set a lower maximum for what an agent may do (*Organization settings › Connections › Agents*). AI apps have no number of their own here: what an app may do is what you allowed it.

## Agents

| What                                                     | Number                                                                                                                                               |
| -------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| A person has at most                                     | 50 agents                                                                                                                                            |
| An agent has at most                                     | 20 keys                                                                                                                                              |
| A new agent is held to at most                           | 60 changes a minute                                                                                                                                  |
| A new agent works on at most                             | 5 issues at once                                                                                                                                     |
| A new agent may try one issue at most                    | 5 times                                                                                                                                              |
| One hand-over names at most                              | 100 issues                                                                                                                                           |
| A hand-over ends after                                   | 14 days unless you choose another end, at most 90 days                                                                                               |
| A standing rule ends after                               | 30 days unless you choose another end, at most 90 days (no end where your administrators allow rules that never run out); you are told 3 days before |
| A change to many issues, also by an agent, names at most | 1000 issues                                                                                                                                          |

## The assistant

| What                                   | Number                                                                                                                                          |
| -------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| A question to the assistant is at most | 4000 characters                                                                                                                                 |
| A conversation keeps at most           | 20 turns                                                                                                                                        |
| A turn is at most                      | 8000 characters                                                                                                                                 |
| The assistant looks things up at most  | 8 times for one question until an administrator sets another most (also *No limit*); you can choose a lower number in *My settings › Assistant* |
| The assistant proposes at most         | 10 changes at once; a proposal waits 10 minutes for *Apply*                                                                                     |
| The calls of tools are kept for        | 90 days                                                                                                                                         |

See [The AI guide](literacy.md) and [Agents](../agents/README.md).
